plainTranslation: Raw chemistry. The Venus person feels pursued and adored; the Mars person feels the chase. Strong physical pull. Easy to mistake heat for fit. Let it run, but check whether anything holds it up beyond attraction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
